title: Etale and finite presentation of coefficient lift
statement: For every commutative ring A, ideal I, square Jacobian presentation P of an A/I-algebra B as in [lem-exc-etale-jacobian-presentation], and chosen coefficient lift L of [def-exc-etale-algebra-lift], L.LiftRing is etale and finitely presented over A.

proof.text: The Option (Fin m)-indexed quotient presentation has block triangular Jacobian with determinant Delta squared. The last relation t * Delta = 1 makes this a unit. Its square Jacobian presentation gives etaleness, and Algebra.Etale includes finite presentation.
